thread.title: Wall Street opens lower as Apple sales warning drags tech

author: Reuters
title: Wall Street opens lower as Apple sales warning drags tech
text:
Wall Street opens lower as Apple sales warning drags tech Wall Street opens lower as Apple sales warning drags tech A trader works on the floor at the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) in New York City, New York, U.S. Jan 03 2019 8 mins ago
Bengaluru: U.S. stocks opened lower on Thursday, weighed by a drop in the technology sector after Apple Inc’s (AAPL.O) rare sales warning inflamed fears that the Sino-U.S. trade war and a slowing China economy would eat into corporate profits more than expected.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 169.85 points, or 0.73 percent, at the open to 23,176.39. The S&P 500 opened lower by 18.11 points, or 0.72 percent, at 2,491.92. The Nasdaq Composite dropped 81.16 points, or 1.22 percent, to 6,584.77 at the opening bell.
